mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, page_path AS pagePath, title, page_type AS pageType, content_hash AS contentHash, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM WikiPage WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND title = #{title}

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, page_path AS pagePath, title, page_type AS pageType, content_hash AS contentHash, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM WikiPage WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND page_path = #{pagePath}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WikiPage (workspace_id, page_path, title, page_type, content_hash, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{pagePath}, #{title}, #{pageType}, #{contentHash}, #{content}, GETUTCDATE(), GETUTCDATE())
mapper.update: UPDATE WikiPage SET page_path = #{pagePath}, title = #{title}, page_type = #{pageType}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, content = #{content}, updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND page_path = #{pagePath}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO WikiPage AS Target USING (SELECT #{workspaceId} AS workspace_id, #{pagePath} AS page_path) AS Source ON (Target.workspace_id = Source.workspace_id AND Target.page_path = Source.page_path) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET title = #{title}, page_type = #{pageType}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, content = #{content}, updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (workspace_id, page_path, title, page_type, content_hash, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{pagePath}, #{title}, #{pageType}, #{contentHash}, #{content}, GETUTCDATE(), GETUTCDATE());
